lines.en: I bought this jacket last week, but the zip broke the first time I wore it.
Could I speak to the manager, please? I would like to return this item and get my money back.
The shop assistant told me that I needed the receipt, which I had unfortunately left at home.
I usually compare prices online before I buy anything expensive, because it can save me a lot of money.
Although the sale looked attractive, most of the items were only a little cheaper than usual.
The delivery was supposed to arrive on Monday, but I am still waiting for it on Friday.
I would have bought the larger size if they had had it in stock.
She complained politely, and the company offered her a replacement as well as a small discount.
Before you pay, check whether the price includes delivery, because some websites add it at the end.
It is not always worth paying more for a famous brand, since cheaper products are often just as good.
